candidate.blueprint_topic: Management of Care — benchmarking and nursing quality improvement
candidate.educational_objective: Explain how external nursing-quality benchmarking supports local quality-improvement efforts.

options.A: It replaces the hospital's internal quality-improvement work
options.B: It allows comparison of nursing performance with external benchmarks to identify improvement opportunities
options.C: It collects nursing data without supporting performance improvement
options.D: It tracks only financial performance rather than nursing-sensitive measures

candidate.rationale: The current NDNQI program provides nursing-quality data and benchmarking so organizations can compare performance across facilities and nursing units and use those insights to improve quality. Benchmarking complements, rather than replaces, local quality-improvement work. B is correct.
candidate.source_claim_supported: NDNQI allows healthcare organizations to compare nursing performance across facilities and units using nursing-sensitive measures and benchmarking data to support improvement.
candidate.source_document_title: National Database of Nursing Quality Indicators (NDNQI)
